name: action_s1008
why_preserved: Rated BEST in a blind listening test of ten pieces, while the six-feature corpus-distance ranking placed it 2nd from last of 53 eligible pieces. It is the clearest evidence that typicality is not quality, and a listening reference -- not a target to fit a ranking to.

pipeline.arranger: arrange_for_nes with chord arpeggiation across k=4 sub-row slots

characterisation: Motif participation 1.00: every melodic note belongs to a recurring figure. Scored as maximally atypical by a two-sided metric, and the listener's favourite -- a strongly repeated riff is plausibly what makes action music work.
Stepwise fraction 1.00: the melody moves entirely by step, no leaps at all, against a corpus median of 0.328.
Pitch-class entropy 2.25 bits against a corpus median of 2.605, so pitch variety is close to typical -- the atypicality is in repetition and melodic contour, not in the notes used.
Notes per bar 20.8 against a corpus median of 31.3: sparser than typical.
IOI entropy 2.23 against a corpus median of 1.38: rhythmically more varied than typical, not less.
13 bars rather than 8, since this predates bar-accurate termination.
All four channels sound, with 136 percussion events.
do_not: Do not treat these figures as targets. They come from one piece and one listener judgement, and fitting a ranking to them is the error the blind test was designed to catch.
